# Introduction

Convert the **latest annotated BANKSY `SpatialExperiment`** into per-sample spatial
AnnData objects (`<sample_id>_<histology>_spatial.h5ad`) -- the spatial side of each
ENVI training pair (the single-nucleus side comes from `h5ad_2_sample_h5ad.qmd`).

-   Input object (same one used by
    `niche/proseg_output_analysis/celltype_niche_histology_enrichment.qmd`):
    `youyun/plgg/data/banksy_param_search/k1_15_k2_30_lambda1_0.2_lambda2_0.8_npcs_20_kct_50_resct_0.5,1_kni_50_resni_0.5,1/banksy_clusters_connected_annotated_k_geom_15_30_pc_20_lam_0.2_0.8_kct_50_resct_0.2_kni_50_resni_0.5_20260826_115134.rds`
    (final res_ct=0.2 / res_ni=0.5 annotated object).

Cell type and niche are read **directly from the object's own colData** (finalized
`cell_type_clust_...res0.2` / `clust_...res0.5`), the same recipe as
`export_new_object_cell_metadata.R`. The old
`banksy_proseg_cell_cluster_annotation.tsv` merge is dropped -- its cluster numbers
do not map onto this object.

# Data Conversion

We will convert single cell experiment class in the rds object to an AnnData object in Python. 
More specifically, `SingleCellExperiment` class stores the single cell data in R and our spatial data is stored in a `SpatialExperiment` class.

ENVI takes in raw counts and log1p transform the expression

```{r}
.regularise_df <- function(df, drop_single_values = TRUE) {
    if (ncol(df) == 0) df[["name"]] <- rownames(df)
    if (drop_single_values) {
        k_singular <- sapply(df, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1)
        if (sum(k_singular) > 0) {
        warning(
            paste("Dropping single category variables:"),
            paste(colnames(df)[k_singular], collapse = ", ")
        )
        }
        df <- df[, !k_singular, drop = F]
        if (ncol(df) == 0) df[["name"]] <- rownames(df)
    }
    return(df)
}
```

```{r}
spe2anndata <- function(obj, outFile = NULL, main_layer = "counts", transfer_layers = NULL, drop_single_values = TRUE) {
    if (!requireNamespace("SummarizedExperiment")) {
        stop("This function requires the 'SummarizedExperiment' package.")
    }
    if (!requireNamespace("SingleCellExperiment")) {
        stop("This function requires the 'SingleCellExperiment' package.")
    }
    if (!requireNamespace('SpatialExperiment')) {
        stop("This function requires the 'SpatialExperiment' package.")
    }

    assay_names <- SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(obj)
    main_layer <- match.arg(main_layer, assay_names)
    transfer_layers <- transfer_layers[transfer_layers %in% assay_names]
    transfer_layers <- transfer_layers[transfer_layers != main_layer]

    X <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(obj, main_layer)

    obs <- .regularise_df(as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(obj)), drop_single_values = drop_single_values)

    var <- .regularise_df(as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(obj)), drop_single_values = drop_single_values)

    obsm <- NULL
    reductions <- SingleCellExperiment::reducedDimNames(obj)
    if (length(reductions) > 0) {
        obsm <- sapply(
            reductions,
            function(name) {
                as.matrix(
                    SingleCellExperiment::reducedDim(obj, type = name)
                )
            },
            simplify = FALSE
        )
        names(obsm) <- paste0(
            "X_", tolower(SingleCellExperiment::reducedDimNames(obj))
        )
    }
    # adding in spatial coordinates
    obsm[['spatial']] <- spatialCoords(obj)

    layers <- list()
    for (layer in transfer_layers) {
        mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(obj, layer)
        if (all(dim(mat) == dim(X))) layers[[layer]] <- Matrix::t(mat)
    }

    anndata <- reticulate::import("anndata", convert = FALSE)

    adata <- anndata$AnnData(
        X = Matrix::t(X),
        obs = obs,
        var = var,
        obsm = obsm,
        layers = layers
    )

    if (!is.null(outFile)) {
        adata$write(outFile, compression = "gzip")
    }

    adata
}
```

```{r}
# Latest annotated BANKSY object (same object as the enrichment notebook). Lives on
# the cluster storage, reachable via workdir on both the mac mount and argos.
banksy_embeddings <- readRDS(paste0(
    workdir,
    "youyun/plgg/data/banksy_param_search/k1_15_k2_30_lambda1_0.2_lambda2_0.8_npcs_20_kct_50_resct_0.5,1_kni_50_resni_0.5,1/",
    "banksy_clusters_connected_annotated_k_geom_15_30_pc_20_lam_0.2_0.8_kct_50_resct_0.2_kni_50_resni_0.5_20260826_115134.rds"
))

# assays present -> confirms the expression layer used as X below (fail fast if the
# expected layer name changed in this object rather than silently exporting the wrong one)
cat("assayNames:", paste(assayNames(banksy_embeddings), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("reducedDimNames:", paste(reducedDimNames(banksy_embeddings), collapse = ", "), "\n")
main_layer <- "normcounts"   # prior ENVI convention: log-normalized expression as X
stopifnot(main_layer %in% assayNames(banksy_embeddings))

# Finalized cell type + niche read straight from the object's own colData (same recipe
# as export_new_object_cell_metadata.R). No join against the stale
# banksy_proseg_cell_cluster_annotation.tsv -- its cluster numbers don't map here.
# These give the canonical `cell_type`/`niche` obs columns the downstream notebooks and
# the cell_metadata TSV use; the full-length source columns still ride along via spe2anndata.
banksy_embeddings$cell_type <- as.character(banksy_embeddings$cell_type_clust_Harmony_BANKSY_lam0.2_k50_res0.2)
banksy_embeddings$niche     <- as.character(banksy_embeddings$clust_Harmony_BANKSY_lam0.8_k50_res0.5)
# sample_id stored numeric in this object -> character for a clean per-sample subset + filename token
banksy_embeddings$sample_id <- as.character(banksy_embeddings$sample_id)

# anndata can't write an obs column that mixes strings with NA (e.g. `alteration`):
# it errors with "Can't implicitly convert non-string objects to strings". Coerce every
# character/factor colData column to character with NA -> "NA" so the h5ad write succeeds.
# (The old converter special-cased only `alteration`; this generalizes it to all such cols.)
cd_fix <- colData(banksy_embeddings)
for (col in colnames(cd_fix)) {
    v <- cd_fix[[col]]
    if (is.factor(v) || is.character(v)) {
        v <- as.character(v)
        v[is.na(v)] <- "NA"
        cd_fix[[col]] <- v
    }
}
colData(banksy_embeddings) <- cd_fix

sample_histology <- as.data.table(unique(colData(banksy_embeddings)[, c("sample_id", "histology")]))
sample_histology[, sample_id := as.character(sample_id)]
sample_histology[, histology := as.character(histology)]

use_condaenv('/mnt/storage/dept/medonc/beroukhim/youyun/util/miniforge3/envs/spatial')

# One spatial h5ad per (sample, histology); obs_names = colnames = cell_id
# ('barcode-1__sampleID'), which is how downstream re-joins labels by cell_id.
invisible(mapply(
    function(x, y) {
        spe_sample <- banksy_embeddings[, banksy_embeddings$sample_id == x]
        spe2anndata(
            spe_sample,
            outFile = paste0(
                workdir, "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/",
                x, '_', gsub(' ', '_', y), "_spatial.h5ad"
            ),
            main_layer = main_layer,
            drop_single_values = FALSE   # keep per-sample-constant cols (histology, cell_type, ...)
        )
        NULL
    },
    sample_histology$sample_id,
    sample_histology$histology
))
```
